assertions: He will not obtain the desired parsonage/benefice — the suit fails outright, not merely delayed success

There is no link between the querent and the benefice: neither the lord of the Ascendant nor the Moon aspects Jupiter, lord of the 9th, neither is placed in the 9th, and there is no translation or collection of light and no reception between the significators, so no intermediary or patron completes the matter for him
Saturn impedited in the Ascendant infortunes the whole question: the querent himself is the hindered party, weighed down and blocked from the start
He meets open opposition: Venus in the 7th house opposing the Ascendant points to an opposing party/interest standing against his suit

The Moon, separating from a trine and applying to an opposition of Mercury, lord of the 3rd, brings adverse messages, reports or talk — third-house channels work against him rather than carrying his suit forward
This benefice will not restore his former place or credit: having lost his previous good place, he remains without this parsonage and must look elsewhere for his living
method: Classical horary astrology after Lilly, Christian Astrology Book II — judgment by the enumerated testimonies between lord of the Ascendant, the Moon, and Jupiter lord of the 9th as significator of the benefice
reasoning: Seven negative testimonies converge: (1) Saturn impedited in the Ascendant infortunes the question; (2) Jupiter lord of the 9th (the benefice) is in no aspect with the lord of the Ascendant; (3) the Moon is in no aspect with Jupiter either; (4) neither lord of the Ascendant nor Moon is placed in the 9th; (5) no translation or collection of light and no reception joins the significators, so the matter cannot be perfected; (6) the Moon separates from a trine and applies to an opposition of Mercury lord of the 3rd, an adverse applying aspect through messages/reports; (7) Venus in the 7th opposes the Ascendant, showing opposition to the querent. With no aspect, no reception and no light-transfer, there is no perfection — the single-point question is answered negative outright rather than as a delay, and no timing for obtainment can be given because obtainment itself is denied.
summary: He will not obtain the desired parsonage; every testimony is negative and no connection between querent and benefice is perfected.
